summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Business Acquisition Report on Form 6-K detailing its acquisition of Maritime Resources Corp. completed November 13, 2025. Under a court-approved plan of arrangement, New Found Gold acquired all Maritime shares not already owned (total 125,672,284 shares) at an exchange ratio of 0.750 New Found Gold shares per Maritime share, implying a value based on the ratio. No cash consideration or premium percentage was disclosed. The board of New Found Gold recommended the arrangement; no advisor named. Outstanding stock options and warrants were exchanged on an adjusted basis. The transaction consolidated gold assets including the Hammerdown project and processing mills. Watch for integration updates and future production milestones.
